name: FaceReady
summary: AI de-aging virtual camera for Mac and Windows that makes your face look younger in video calls, with processing on your own computer.
best_for: people who join video calls from a Mac or Windows 11 PC and want an AI de-aging filter that runs on the computer itself
skip_if: you use an Intel Mac or Windows 10, you want a refund policy, or you need the camera on more than two computers
honest_knock: There are no refunds, so a wrong purchase is a sunk cost after the 7-day trial. Intel Macs, Windows 10 and macOS versions older than 14 are not supported, and the free trial puts a watermark on your picture.

pricing.notes: (read 2026-11-09 on faceready.ai/pricing) FaceReady costs $19.99 a month, or $119.88 a year, which the page says works out at $9.99 a month. One subscription covers up to two computers, Mac or Windows. The 7-day trial carries a "FaceReady free trial" mark on the picture and needs no card; paid plans have no watermark and no time limit. You can start monthly and move to yearly later. The pricing page says the company does not give refunds. Prices are in US dollars; any tax is added at checkout and we did not open checkout, so the tax amount is not known.
